create_filesystem_registry: create a FileSystemRegistry to resolve filesystem instances based on path patterns
use_global_filesystem: use GlobalFileSystem to open and read files from local or S3 paths transparently
copy_from_local_to_remote: copy a local file or directory to a remote S3 path using copy_from_local
walk_directory_glob: walk a directory tree and glob for matching files using the FileSystem interface
manage_temp_directory: create and manage a temporary directory on local or remote filesystems using tmp_directory
